PROCEDURE CODE
1149
The affixing of seals is applied for to the justice of the peace, either by petition or by an oral declaration of which the registrar shall draw up the record.
The application is made at the registry. If the registry is closed, it may, if extremely urgent, be presented to the judge in his chambers and, where appropriate, recorded by him.
The application may be signed by the applicant, by his agent approved by the judge, by his lawyer or by his notary.   Business agents may not be approved as proxies.
